data: What is the approximate BLEU value for the red line in the right graph at the x-axis label 2~3?

The right graph shows the BLEU variation with respect to reentrancy numbers. The red line represents the model with Ke=4, and the blue line represents the model with Ke=0. At the x-axis label 2~3, the red line appears to be around 32. Therefore, the approximate BLEU value for the red line in the right graph at the x-axis label 2~3 is 32.
